subject.title: fix(logging): keep JSON console output structured across CLI routes

question: Should an operator who sets `logging.consoleStyle: "json"` receive JSONL for early CLI validation, container-dispatch, and direct diagnostic output in addition to normal subsystem and captured console logs?
rationale: The patch appears internally consistent and preserves explicit command `--json` results, but expanding a configuration-selected output format across early error paths is an operator-facing compatibility decision that code review cannot infer.

options.title: Adopt stream-wide JSONL
options.body: Accept the explicit `json` setting as applying to the repaired early CLI and direct-diagnostic paths, then refresh the branch against current `main`.

options.title: Keep early diagnostics human-readable
options.body: Narrow the patch so only established runtime console and subsystem paths are structured, preserving current text formatting for early CLI diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Adopt stream-wide JSONL
recommendation.body: Accept the explicit `json` setting as applying to the repaired early CLI and direct-diagnostic paths, then refresh the branch against current `main`.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation and its compatibility framing were developed in this branch, including the CLI startup boundary.
